title: NPS
hint: The button copies /showlocation: paste it in the game chat (Enter, Ctrl+V, Enter). Typing the command yourself works too.
waiting: /showlocation is copied: paste it in the game chat (Enter, Ctrl+V, Enter).
copyFailed: Could not copy /showlocation. Type the command in the game chat.

screen.calibrateHint: Draw the area where the game shows the coordinates
screen.setup: For continuous tracking: type r_displayInfo 1 in the game console (~ key), then calibrate by drawing a box around the “Zone: … Pos:” lines at the top right.
screen.calibrationEmpty: Area saved, but no position could be read in it. Check that r_displayInfo 1 is on and that the area covers the “Zone: SolarSystem… Pos:” line.
screen.tooSmall: Area too small: draw it wider, from the first “Zone” line down to the FPS line.
screen.unreadable: No position read on screen: is r_displayInfo 1 on? Nothing may cover the area, not even this window.

noPlaces: No place has coordinates yet: type some in, or record your position on the spot so a place has one.
noDestination: Pick a recorded place, or type in coordinates.
needFix: Update your position to know where it is.
unknownBody: This place sits on a celestial body the NPS does not know.
otherSystem: This place is in the {system} system: get there first, the NPS only guides within a system.
record: Record my position for a place
heading: Heading {degrees}° {point}
moveThenRefresh: Move a little, then update again: two readings give your direction.
moveMore: You have barely moved since the previous reading: go a bit further before updating.
moveLive: Move a little: your direction shows up after a few metres.
closing: Closing in at {speed} m/s · arrival in {eta}
recordConfirm: Record your latest reading as the position of “{name}”?
recordHint: Reading from {age} s ago. Stand where one arrives at the place, and update before sending if you have moved.
recordOtherSystem: This place is in the {system} system, not the one you are in: your position does not belong to it.
recordPending: Thanks! The position will be published after review.

errors.suspended: Your contributions are suspended by moderation.
errors.tooManyPending: You already have 5 contributions waiting for review.
errors.noChange: This place already has exactly this position.
errors.invalidInput: This position could not be recorded: the celestial body may no longer be known.

coordinatesHint: Type in coordinates as the destination

dial.travelUpLabel: Compass: the arrow shows the destination relative to your direction
dial.northUpLabel: Compass: the arrow shows the heading to the destination, north up
dial.spaceLabel: Gap between your trajectory and the destination

manual.bodyHint: The same values as under “My position” when standing there. Altitude above the ground, 0 if empty.
manual.spaceHint: System coordinates, like those of /showlocation: paste the line the game copied into a field to fill them all. Near a planet they only hold at the time of the reading, since the planet turns.
manual.name: Name (optional)
manual.invalidGeo: Check the values: latitude between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180.
manual.invalidXyz: Type in all three coordinates X, Y and Z.
manual.noBodies: Planets and moons are not loaded from the site yet: only system coordinates can be typed in.
